text: Target reported a 1.5% year-over-year revenue decline and a 2.5% drop in comparable sales for the quarter ended Jan. 31. Store comparable sales fell 3.9%, while digital rose 1.9%. Transactions declined 2.9%. Net income decreased to $1.05B from $1.10B. Customer traffic has fallen for four consecutive quarters.

meta.note: Positive February sales and forward guidance excluded to preserve snapshot constraint.

text: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick agreed to testify before the House Oversight Commitee regarding ties to Jeffrey Epstein after DOJ file releases and publicized photographs. A subpoena was announced by a commitee member. Testimony is expected behind closed doors. The White House publicly affirmed continued support.
